en: Advertising postcard in German featuring a young boy in traditional Alpine clothing (green hat with feather, grey jacket, dark shorts, green legwarmers) holding a walking stick. The upper part is dominated by stylized text with an imperial double-headed eagle coat of arms and promotional wording for a specialty clothing shop in Graz, Styria, offering Edelweiss-loden and weatherproof garments. The lower margin includes the caption identifying the child as "Mein Söhnchen Alexander" and a small printer's credit along the left edge.
